## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `trust-weighted-context-assembly`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-07-28T22:37:06.038Z.

Catalog entry, slug trust-weighted-context-assembly, added 2026-07-28 by slug per the pm-g8t7b9 ordinal-collision rule. Extends the catalog; renumbers nothing.

THE ASSUMPTION EVERY EXISTING ENTRY MAKES. Entries (1) through (28) score recorded evidence on relevance, recency, structure, outcome distance, and cost. Not one of them scores the WRITER. Every signal is treated as equally credible regardless of which agent, harness, model, or effort level produced it, and regardless of whether that writer's prior contributions turned out to be correct. On a single-author workspace that assumption is free. On a fleet of a thousand agents of mixed capability it is the load-bearing weakness of the whole engine, because context assembled from a confidently wrong writer is indistinguishable from context assembled from a careful one, and the assembly is what the next agent acts on. Roadmap horizon I states the general problem - correctness when part of the fleet is wrong - and this entry is the relevance-engine half of it.

WHAT THE RECORD ALREADY SUPPORTS, AND WHAT IT DOES NOT. The provenance now present on history entries is a real substrate: author with an author_source distinguishing detected from asserted, agent_harness, agent_instance which is live on 5,108 entries, and agent_provenance carrying effort as a structured value with its own source - verified live as effort xhigh from environment. That is enough to group evidence by writer and by writer class. Three things are missing and each bounds what this entry can compute. Model is null on all 40,353 entries because the primary harness publishes no model environment key at all, owned by pm-ffz0a9. Session topic and role are carried by zero entries and must be supplied rather than detected, owned by pm-itsjf0. And identity itself is not unique under the mandated automatic detection, since every process of one harness collapses to the same author string, owned by pm-z8qd4k. So trust can be computed per harness and per instance today, per model when ffz0a9 lands, and per principal only when identity is verifiable rather than merely detected.

THE ALGORITHM. A per-writer credibility posterior, consumed as a scoring multiplier and as an assembly-composition constraint.

Estimation. Treat each writer as a unit with a Beta-distributed reliability whose evidence is its own recorded outcomes: an assertion later contradicted by a recorded correction, a filed defect later closed as not-a-defect, an edge later retired, a refusal later overturned. These are all observable in the immutable record without any human labelling, which is what makes the estimate maintainable. Shrink aggressively toward the writer's class prior - harness, then model, then effort tier - using the hierarchical empirical-Bayes machinery of (21), because most writers will have too few observations to estimate individually and an unshrunk estimate on three observations is noise wearing a number.

Application, in two distinct ways that must not be conflated. As a multiplier, credibility scales an item's or assertion's contribution to the relevance score, bounded so that no writer can be scored to zero - a low-trust writer's evidence is discounted, never censored, because censorship makes the corpus unverifiable and hides the disagreement that (14) exists to arbitrate. As a composition constraint, an assembly must not be sourced predominantly from one low-trust writer even when that writer's items score highest: the assembly declares its trust profile and the packer diversifies across writers when the profile is thin. This is where the entry composes with (24) fleet-joint diversification, which diversifies across agents to reduce redundant work; here diversification serves correctness rather than coverage, and the two objectives can disagree - a case the packer must resolve explicitly rather than by accident of ordering.

Disclosure, which is not optional. Any assembly whose scores were modified by trust must say so, name the dimension, and remain reproducible. pm-8bgeye already requires an assembly to record the inputs that produced it; a credibility posterior is such an input and must appear in the attestation, or the same request will produce different answers as posteriors move with no way to explain the difference. An undisclosed trust weight is indistinguishable from a ranking bug.

Retroactive revision, the hardest property and the one that makes this worth designing early. When a writer's credibility falls, every assembly that was built on its evidence is retrospectively suspect. The record is immutable and must stay so, which means revision cannot rewrite anything - it must be expressible as a later assertion that reweights the past without altering it. Horizon I names this as retroactive quarantine and graded trust. The design constraint this entry contributes is that quarantine must be a recorded, reversible assertion carrying its own provenance, so a trust decision is itself auditable and a wrongly quarantined writer can be restored without erasing the quarantine.

DEGENERACY. On a single-writer workspace every posterior equals the class prior, every multiplier is the same constant, the composition constraint is vacuous, and the entry must be provably a no-op - identical output, no measurable cost. That is the acceptance test, and it is the same test (23) and (24) carry, for the same reason: a fleet feature that changes single-agent behaviour is a regression disguised as a capability.

BOUNDARIES. (20) merge-probability-weighted provenance ranking weights evidence by how likely it is to survive a merge, which is about durability, not credibility - evidence certain to merge can still be wrong. pm-u14c owns per-entry authenticity, which is whether a writer is who it claims; trust presumes authenticity and cannot substitute for it. pm-3oqjnc owns routing work to capable agents, which acts before the work; this acts on what they wrote afterwards. pm-2vs1za owns comparing cost to forecast value, and a credibility posterior is one of its inputs rather than a competitor to it.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
